nodes.name: auth.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the authentication screens (login/register/reset) providing a dark gradient hero background, grid overlays, glow effects, topbar, and form/panel layout classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of layered radial/linear gradients, backdrop blur, and pseudo-decorative grid/glow elements for a dark-themed auth UI.

nodes.name: variables.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS custom properties defining the design system tokens: color palette, typography, border radii, shadows, and transition timings shared across the frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses :root-scoped CSS custom properties as a lightweight design token system.

nodes.name: welcome-demo.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the welcome/demo landing page, styling a fixed navigation bar, hero sections, action buttons, and page layout with a light theme referencing shared design token variables.
nodes.languageNotes: References design tokens from variables.css (e.g. var(--font-sans)) and uses backdrop-filter blur for a sticky translucent nav bar.

nodes.name: welcome.css
nodes.summary: Defines floating/bobbing keyframe animations for the AI Mentor Robot illustration shown on the welcome page, animating its head, body, and arms independently.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS @keyframes with staggered timing/easing per robot part to create a layered floating effect.
